class.name: flux2_tools/Image
class.description: Shows a sensor_msgs/Image published over a flux2 channel, read from shared memory inside rviz2 without going through DDS.

class.name: flux2_tools/PointCloud2
class.description: Shows a sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 published over a flux2 channel, read from shared memory inside rviz2 without going through DDS. Rendering is the stock point cloud renderer.

class.name: flux2_tools/DepthCloud
class.description: Back-projects a depth sensor_msgs/Image published over a flux2 channel into 3D points, using the CameraInfo published next to it on DDS. Rendering is the stock point cloud renderer.
